Ampa is a pioneering neurotechnology startup developing brain stimulation technology to help eradicate depression . We will improve millions of lives by making this transformative treatment universally accessible. Joining us means you’ll be part of a rapidly growing startup with significant equity opportunities and a major impact on our future.

What to Expect: Working at Ampa is a rare chance to help transform global mental health and save millions of lives — a level of impact that demands deep commitment. Success here requires resilience, adaptability, and the discipline to put in long hours.

If you thrive in a high-intensity, fast-changing environment and want your work to truly matter, you may do the best work of your life here. Role Overview: Ampa is hiring our first dedicated full cycle sales representative to sell our TMS system to psychiatrists, clinic owners, and mental health practices across the US.

You will own the entire sales motion, from generating your own pipeline to running demos to closing deals. This is high-ticket capital equipment subscription to physician decision-makers, and you will work directly with our founding team as we scale a proven product into a growing market.

Key Responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, demo, negotiate, close, and deposit collection Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, and creative channel development Deliver compelling product demos to psychiatrists and clinic owners, both virtual and in person Build and maintain long-term relationships with clinical customers to facilitate upsells Partner closely with our founding executive team on strategy, positioning, and high-value deals Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasting in our CRM Share market and customer feedback with product and marketing to sharpen our go-to-market What We’re Looking For: 5+ years of full cycle sales experience, with a track record of hunting and closing your own deals Experience selling high-ticket capital equipment or subscription to physician-owned clinics, ideally in medical devices, medtech, or adjacent markets Verifiable quota attainment.

You should be able to walk us through the specific deals that got you to your number Proven ability to break into new accounts and build channels from scratch, without relying on the infrastructure of a large company Consultative, substance-first selling style.

Our buyers are psychiatrists who respond to clinical credibility, ROI clarity, and intelligence Comfort with long sales cycles and cash-pay ROI conversations with practice owners Startup mindset: resourceful, persistent, and energized by ambiguity Why Join Ampa? Impact: Lead the growth of transformative mental health technologies.

Growth: Thrive in a startup environment with rapid innovation. Stability: Enjoy startup benefits with a secure product line. Ownership: Receive substantial equity as an early team member. Logistics: Work Mode: Remote Location: US Employment: Full-time Originally posted on Himalayas

Healthcare AI Enterprise Sales Executive New Logo Acquisition | Healthcare AI & Cloud Transformation Rackspace Technology is building the next generation of healthcare AI infrastructure — and we’re hiring a proven enterprise hunter to lead new logo growth across U.S. health systems and IDNs.

This is a pure acquisition role focused on winning new enterprise healthcare customers navigating AI adoption, cloud modernization, data transformation, and operational automation.

You’ll partner with AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Palantir to bring transformative AI, cloud, and data solutions to some of the largest healthcare organizations in the country.

If you thrive in complex enterprise sales, enjoy building territory from scratch, and want to capitalize on the explosive healthcare AI market, this is a high-impact opportunity with significant earnings upside.

What You’ll Own Build and close a pipeline of net-new healthcare enterprise opportunities Sell complex AI, cloud, data, and managed services solutions into health systems and IDNs Engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CMOs, and executive healthcare leadership Drive full-cycle enterprise sales from prospecting through close Lead strategic multi-stakeholder deals ranging from $500K–$5M+ ACV Partner closely with AWS, Azure, GCP, and Palantir field teams Position Rackspace as a trusted healthcare AI transformation partner What You’ll Sell AI/ML infrastructure and GPU environments Managed multi-cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) Data and analytics platforms HIPAA-compliant security and governance Healthcare AI modernization solutions Palantir Foundry and AIP solutions What We’re Looking For Required Experience 8+ years enterprise technology sales experience Proven success in net-new logo acquisition Experience selling into healthcare providers, IDNs, or health systems Track record closing complex enterprise deals ($500K–$5M+) Strong executive presence and consultative selling skills Experience with cloud, AI, data, analytics, or infrastructure solutions Preferred Experience Existing healthcare executive relationships Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir ecosystems Healthcare AI or digital transformation sales experience Understanding of healthcare data and interoperability environments Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets.

The compensation range for this position ranges from $192,610.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 338,993.60 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Learn more about benefits at Rackspace.

About Rackspace Technology We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions.

We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent.

Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future. More on Rackspace Technology Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day.

And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe.

We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic.

This opportunity is focused on prospecting, relationship-building, and securing commitment to deals .

Once a partnership is locked in, you’ll hand off to an Account Manager who handles all backend setup and execution, allowing you to stay focused on generating new opportunities.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who loves the front end of sales and thrives on conversations and connections—without needing to manage long-term account logistics ! Scope of Work:
Relationship Management: Leverage your existing network to identify and engage potential partners (schools, teams, programs, and community groups).

Presentations: Conduct in-person meetings and demos.

Sales: Prospect and generate new business. Close new partnerships and transition them smoothly to an Account Manager for execution.

Ability to pass a background check.

Clear role focus—no backend admin or long-term account management.
A supportive, collaborative team that values relationships and impact over ego.
A Few Things to Know This is an independent contractor position and does not include a base salary, employer-sponsored benefits, or paid leave. You control the manner, means, and schedule of your activities.

Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters and help people to live a healthier and full life, grow your career, and learn, be your true self. You will have access to:
Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of .
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity
The Sr. Sales rep. at Neuromodulation Spain is a sales position where the individual is responsible for servicing the current customer base, assuring consistent sales growth and achievement of sales goals and targets in assigned territory by identifying opportunities in new accounts and gaining new business while maintaining existing business
She/he will be responsible for effectively dealing with customer complaints and recommending consignment in accounts where necessary

Manage the patient follow up post stimulator implantation when required.
Clinical coverage: Provide technical support to clinicians. Demonstrate procedural steps for all involved physician and staff at sites. Conduct in-service programs for not only the cath lab staff, but for ICU personnel as well. Develop and implement field based physician and staff training programs. Communicate physician feedback and personnel input from case observations.
Train Field Service Engineers, customers and other colleagues when and as appropriate Compliance with local and corporate policies and procedures.
Achieve territory total product sales targets and associated individual product targets. Carry out sales calls, targeting high sales areas for maximum efficiency and develop new business opportunities with existing and potential clients. Monitor market trends and competitor activity in assigned territory.
Develop and Implement comprehensive account sales plans to ensure increase market penetration and establishing new accounts. Plans own territory or account approach and manages own resources. Prepare important tenders.
Analyzes sales statistics: prepares reports, and performs required administrative sales duties, e.g., filing expenses account reports, scheduling appointments, and making travel plan.
Complete and submit timely administration tasks such as customer record keeping (CM), rolling forecasts, monthly highlights, expenses, etc. in line with divisional standards. Maintain close relationships with key accounts and ensure their requirements are being met by the Company's products where possible. Represent Abbott in a professional manner that aligns with Company image, ensuring activities comply with legal and ethical standards.
Maintain business operations in accordance with corporate policies in respect to pricing, quotes, credit terms, expense reporting.
Act as Company ambassador at all time i.e represent the Company in a professional manner and with highest integrity as the prime contact with facilities, physicians and patients.

## The company ##
**Swatch** ist einer der führenden Schweizer Uhrenhersteller und gleichzeitig eine der weltweit berühmtesten Marken. Die ersten Swatch Uhren verblüfften ihr Publikum durch ein revolutionäres Konzept, kreatives Design und die Lust an der Provokation. Die Philosophie der Marke, die auf Farbe, Bewegung, Leichtigkeit und Transparenz basiert, ist in jedem Produkt und Projekt von Swatch deutlich zu erkennen. Die Marke bewahrt zudem eine starke Präsenz in der Welt des Sports und der Kunst.
Für unseren SWATCH Store in **Zürich** suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n motivierte/n, engagierte/n und flexible/n

## Job description ##
**Deine Aufgaben:**
* Aktive Beratung und Verkauf unserer Produkte im Store (Swatch und Flik Flak)
* Sicherstellung eines herzlichen Empfangs sowie eines zuvorkommenden Kundenservices
* Attraktive Präsentation unserer Produkte im Store gemäss den visuellen Vorgaben
* Verantwortung für die korrekte Bedienung und Abrechnung an der Kasse
* Durchführung kleiner Servicearbeiten wie Batteriewechsel und Anpassungen von Uhrenarmbändern
* Sicherstellung eines gepflegten und einladenden Erscheinungsbild des Stores
* Entgegennahme von Lieferungen sowie Unterstützung bei der Warenbewirtschaftung
## Profile ##
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Erfahrung im Verkauf, idealerweise im Bereich Uhren, Schmuck oder Lifestyle-Produkte
* Flexibilität hinsichtlich Einsatzzeiten und Freude am lebendigen Store-Alltag

Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und erfahrene/n, mehrsprachige/n Sales Associate, welche/r sich in einem dynamischen, internationalen Arbeitsumfeld mit grosser Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und Eigenverantwortung wohlfühlt.
Als Sales Associate bist du Teil unseres internationalen Teams, das exzellenten Kundenservice bietet, den Verkauf fördert und zum Erfolg unserer Swatch Stores beiträgt. Werde Teil unseres Teams und repräsentiere die Marke mit Begeisterung, Produktwissen und einer starken Kundenorientierung.
## Languages ##
Sehr gute **Deutsch**\- und **Englisch**kenntnisse, **Französisch** und weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

**Conseiller de Ventes (H/F)**
**Mission**
Dans le cadre de cette fonction, vous serez en charge d'accueillir et suivre de manière irréprochable nos clients afin d'identifier leurs attentes. De leur proposer les garde-temps et articles de joaillerie les plus appropriés. Vous serez le garant de la philosophie, de la culture et des valeurs que Patek Philippe souhaite transmettre.
**Responsabilités**
* Accueillir, informer, conseiller les clients afin de satisfaire leurs demandes au mieux et de permettre une fidélisation de notre clientèle.
* Identifier les attentes du client et s'efforcer de réorienter le client sur d'autres références disponibles avec tact et diplomatie.
* Accompagner le client du début à la fin de la visite dans nos Salons.
* Assurer le bien-être du client, faire en sorte qu'il se sente le bienvenu durant toute sa visite et qu'il puisse bénéficier d'une expérience client à la hauteur de ses attentes.
* Apporter des explications techniques et/ou historiques précises aux clients sur les grandes complications.

About Halter
At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .
To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.
As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative.

This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.
Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.
This role covers the Sandhills region in Nebraska. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

s.h: What your day could look like
s.t:
Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.
In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.
Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.
Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.
Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.
Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.
Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.
Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.
Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.
Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.
Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.
You’ll be great if you exhibit
Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.
Ranching / Cattle Experience: Y ou know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.
Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

HireHawk connects skilled professionals with career opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, helping organizations build high-performing remote teams around the world. We believe great people should be able to do meaningful work from wherever they are, with clear expectations, strong support, and an outcomes-focused culture.
For this opportunity, HireHawk is recruiting for a legal-sector client focused on converting an established pipeline of prospects into qualified potential client opportunities.

As a Cold Caller/outbound sales representative, your focus is simple: turn existing leads into conversations and identify which prospects should move forward with the firm. You will work from lead lists created by a separate Lead Generation Specialist, so you can spend your time calling, qualifying, following up, and creating opportunities rather than sourcing prospects or running marketing campaigns.
This is a high-volume phone role, with approximately 80–100 outbound calls per day when sufficient leads are available. You will have clear ownership of your outreach activity and will play a direct role in helping the firm connect with prospective clients who may need its services.

Conduct approximately 80–100 outbound calls per day when sufficient leads are available, maintaining professional and consistent outreach throughout the day.
Convert existing lead lists into real conversations with prospective clients. Introduce the firm clearly and confidently while quickly establishing the purpose and relevance of each call.
Ask thoughtful questions to identify interest, potential case opportunities, and whether a prospect may be a viable client.
Move qualified prospects to the appropriate next step with the firm based on established processes.
Follow up consistently with prospects who require additional contact before making a decision.
Accurately document call outcomes, prospect status, follow-up actions, and relevant conversation details.
Work closely with the Lead Generation Specialist by focusing on conversion while they handle prospect sourcing and database development.
Maintain consistent outreach activity and organized follow-through while working independently in a remote environment.

Proven experience in cold calling, outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, or phone-based lead qualification.
Strong spoken English with clear, confident, and professional phone communication.
Comfortable completing approximately 80–100 outbound calls per day when sufficient leads are available.
Comfortable initiating conversations with people who have not previously spoken with the firm.
Strong listening and questioning skills with the ability to identify interest and potential opportunities quickly.
Ability to work consistently from existing lead lists and maintain organized follow-up records.

Experience using CRM platforms, outbound dialers, spreadsheets, or similar prospect-management tools.
Previous experience making outbound calls for a law firm or legal-services organization.
Familiarity with employment law or employment-related client intake.

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.
Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.
Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.
You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.
What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.
You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.
This is not a script-and-cadence BDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

Build coverage across AWS US sales territories: account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers (Data, AI/ML, Modernization).
Reach out, follow up, show up at AWS Summits and regional partner events, and build named relationships.
Walk AWS reps through what agent-native AWS modernization means in practice and why it's different from what every other partner in their deck says.
Anchor every conversation in shipped Mactores case studies: named customer, named baseline, named outcome, time-to-value, cost reduction.
Identify customer fit, frame the business problem, articulate Mactores' business value, and tee up the technical demo.
Hand off to the forward-deployed engineer for the architecture walkthrough. Your job is to make sure the FDE walks into a qualified room.
Source Amazon-originated opportunities into the Mactores pipeline, register them in ACE, and keep the AWS rep in the loop through cycle close.
Feed market signal back to Mactores leadership, what AWS reps hear from customers, where the partner conversation is shifting, and which messaging lands.

3–5 years in a BDR, SDR, or partner-development role, with a demonstrated ability to source qualified pipeline from a cold start.
Comfort talking to AWS field teams. Prior work at an AWS partner, exposure to AWS Partner Central, ACE, or MAP, and time on the floor at AWS Summits or re:Invent are preferred, not required but they shorten the ramp.
Comfort with the technical concepts of cloud modernization, data platforms, and agentic AI without being the engineer in the room. You can read an architecture diagram, talk through a case study, and name where the customer's pain is. You don't need to debug a Lambda.
Sharp business-value articulation: you can take a messy customer problem statement, restate it in two sentences, and show how Mactores ships against it.
A self-managed work style. Remote role, distributed AWS field, no daily stand-up babysitting your activity.
Travel roughly 30% across the US AWS offices, customer sites, AWS Summits, re:Invent, and regional partner events.
How we work?
We're not selling a roadmap. Our agents run in production today, and our forward-deployed engineers ship with them every day. Mactores is MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and holds seven AWS Consulting Competencies and seventeen Service Validations, the credentials that make an AWS rep's routing decision easy.
The agent-native category window is 6–12 months. After that, "agent-native" becomes commodity vocabulary the way "cloud-native" did. We're on the early side of that window, and the BDR who plants the flag in AWS field conversations now will own those relationships when the category gets loud. You'll join an existing partnership and sales motion, the system works. Your job is to add territory coverage and AWS-originated pipeline to it, not invent the function from scratch.
How you'll be measured
A combination of net-new logos and AWS-originated revenue. Not call counts, not email volume, not meetings booked for their own sake. The leading indicator is qualified AWS-sourced pipeline. The lagging indicator is closed-won revenue from customers who came in through the AWS field. Quota structure and targets are discussed in the interview process.

Die zentralisierte **AMAG Informatik** in Cham ZG verantwortet mit ihren ca. 200 Mitarbeitenden für alle Konzernbereiche die gesamte IT-Wertschöpfungskette, vom Projekt über die Entwicklung und Integration bis hin zum Betrieb und Support.
Du möchtest die nächste Generation von AI Agents, Copilots und intelligenter Automatisierung aktiv mitgestalten?
Bei uns erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Agentic AI und intelligente Automatisierung auf die nächste Stufe zu heben. Gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklungs- und Plattformteams entwickelst du Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen und unternehmensweit Wirkung entfalten.
Für unser **Intelligent Automation**\-Team suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als **Senior Agentic Automation Consultant (m/w/d)**, die als fachliche Leitfigur für Agentic Automation agiert und Technologiekompetenz, Business-Verständnis und Innovationskraft erfolgreich verbindet.
## Wie wir dich begeistern ##
* **Spezialkonditionen bei Fahrzeugkauf und Service:** Für dich und deine Familie - weil wir wissen, wie wichtig Mobilität ist
* **Reisen mit Vergünstigungen:** Weltweit günstiger unterwegs mit Europcar
* **ZIF:** Zusätzliche individuelle Freitage - Kaufe dir zusätzliche Urlaubstage und gönne dir eine wohlverdiente längere Auszeit
* **Flexibilität leben:** Vereinbare Familie, Hobby und Beruf - geniesse die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens
* **Life long learning:** Wir beteiligen uns an deiner Weiterbildung - booste deine Karriere!
* **Fit for free:** Nutze unser kostenloses Fitnessstudio für deine Gesundheit und Fitness
* **Exklusive Deals:** Plattform mit wechselnden Vergünstigungen - entdecke immer wieder neue Angebote und spare dabei
## Was du bei uns bewegen kannst ##
* **AI Innovation:** Du identifizierst, priorisierst und realisierst innovative Agentic-AI-Anwendungsfälle mit strategischer Relevanz und messbarem Business-Nutzen
* **End-to-End Ownership:** Du verantwortest die fachliche Führung von Agentic-Automation-Initiativen von der ersten Idee bis zur nachhaltigen Skalierung im Unternehmenskontext
* **Ecosystem Leadership:** Du führst interdisziplinäre Teams sowie externe Partner fachlich und stellst die erfolgreiche Umsetzung komplexer AI-Initiativen sicher
* **Enterprise Integration:** Du prägst die technische Zielarchitektur für Agentic AI und begleitest die Integration von AI Agents in die bestehende Enterprise-Landschaft
* **Governance Excellence:** Du etablierst Standards, Best Practices und Leitplanken für den sicheren und skalierbaren Einsatz von Agentic AI
* **AI Enablement:** Du wirkst als Trusted Advisor für Fachbereiche und Management und förderst die Einführung von Agentic AI durch Beratung, Coaching und Enablement.
* **Thought Leadership:** Du beobachtest Markttrends, bewertest neue Technologien und bringst innovative Ansätze gezielt in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Agentic-AI-Strategie ein
## Das bringst du mit ##
* **Erfahrung:** Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Einführung und Skalierung von Automatisierungs-, AI- oder Agentic-AI-Lösungen in Enterprise-Umgebungen und hast erfolgreich komplexe Vorhaben mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern begleitet
* **Beratungs- und Stakeholder-Kompetenz:** Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Fachbereich, IT und Management. Dabei gelingt es dir, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen, komplexe Themen verständlich zu kommunizieren und Veränderungen erfolgreich zu begleiten
* **Aus- / Weiterbildung:** Du hast einen Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
* **Technologie- und Architekturkompetenz:** Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen AI, intelligente Automatisierung und Enterprise-Architekturen mit. Du verstehst, wie moderne AI-Lösungen konzipiert, betrieben und skaliert werden, und kannst Business-Anforderungen in nachhaltige und skalierbare Lösungsarchitekturen übersetzen
* **Tools / Technologien:** Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung mit modernen AI-Plattformen wie Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Foundry Agent Service und der Power Platform. Zudem kennst du dich mit Agent-Orchestrierung, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG sowie modernen Frameworks und Methoden zur Entwicklung agentischer Systeme aus
* **Integrationskompetenz:** Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Integration von Unternehmensanwendungen und Datenquellen und verstehst, wie AI-Lösungen sicher, skalierbar und nachhaltig in bestehende Systemlandschaften eingebunden werden. Dabei bewegst du dich sicher im Umfeld von SAP, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, Cloud-Plattformen und modernen Schnittstellen-Technologien
* **Sprachkenntnisse:** Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse; Französisch oder Italienisch sind von Vorteil
* **Personality Fit:** Du überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke, Beratungskompetenz und die Fähigkeit, Business und Technologie erfolgreich zu verbinden
